RESEARCH-CONTEXT0 fixture provenance
=====================================

These fixtures pin literal producer bytes from upstream repositories in this
ecosystem, per this repo's CLAUDE.md "cross-repository evidence rule". This
extension does not re-implement or hand-author the underlying packet shapes;
it validates and displays exactly what the producer emitted.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
research_context_packet.missing_primary_source.json
research_context_packet.complete_neighborhood.json
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
producer_repository = thelaplage/countergraph
producer_ref        = main
producer_commit     = bb407d3e7577c81b0abdbf5d5e28e0dc6b33a87b
producer_pr         = #88 "RESEARCH-CONTEXT0: project question evidence
                       neighborhoods and gap rationale" — MERGED
                       2026-08-18T06:41:41Z.

  NOTE: the RESEARCH-CONTEXT0 dispatch instructions for this extension lane
  described countergraph PR #88 as "still draft". Verified via
  `gh pr view 88 --repo thelaplage/countergraph` at the time this lane ran:
  the PR is in fact MERGED (state=MERGED, mergedAt=2026-08-18T06:41:41Z).
  That is a *more* stable upstream state than the dispatch assumed, not a
  regression, so these fixtures are pinned to countergraph's actual `main`
  rather than to a draft branch. Flagged here for the record, per the
  "verify remote head before merge" ecosystem lesson — assumptions about PR
  status go stale and must be re-checked, not trusted from a prior brief.

producer_modules:
  countergraph/research_gap_packet.py      (schema countergraph.research-gap-packet/v0.1, PR #84, merged)
  countergraph/research_context_packet.py  (schema countergraph.research-context-packet/v0.1, PR #88, merged)

generation: ran build_research_gap_packet() then build_research_context_packet()
  locally (pure computation, no network) against countergraph's own checked-in
  snapshot fixtures, using the exact question_ref each snapshot's own test
  suite uses:

  missing_primary_source.json  <- countergraph fixtures/research_gap/missing_primary_source.json,
                                   question_ref="q:heppner-retirement"
                                   (countergraph's own PR #84 fixture directory already ships the
                                   resulting ResearchGapPacket at
                                   fixtures/research_gap/producer_packet_missing_primary_source.json —
                                   this file is the ResearchContextPacket built on top of that same
                                   gap packet, generated the same way.)

  complete_neighborhood.json   <- countergraph fixtures/research_gap/complete_neighborhood.json,
                                   question_ref="q:portland-head-light-history"
                                   (empty gap_context / gap_item_counts_by_type — no-gaps case)

  generation command (run from thelaplage/countergraph checkout at bb407d3):
    python3 -c "
    import json
    from countergraph.research_gap_packet import build_research_gap_packet
    from countergraph.research_context_packet import build_research_context_packet
    snapshot = json.load(open('fixtures/research_gap/<name>.json'))
    gap_packet = build_research_gap_packet(snapshot, question_ref='<question_ref>')
    ctx_packet = build_research_context_packet(snapshot, gap_packet, question_ref='<question_ref>')
    json.dump(ctx_packet, open('<out>.json', 'w'), indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    "

packet_digest (missing_primary_source)  = sha256:00d418e9902549539746bb8d2dc48a77090aa2007a9955c20689230b838f5bc0
packet_digest (complete_neighborhood)   = sha256:c7899dba37e5ded7c46939d928c805c6ac9528f2f11032a666ae1a629424ace7

This extension does NOT recompute these digests (it has no access to
countergraph's canon.py canonicalization profile and must not become a
second schema/digest authority per CLAUDE.md). Validation here is
structural (required fields + schema string) only; the digest is carried
through and displayed as an opaque provenance value.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
public_object_link.*.json
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
producer_repository = thelaplage/counterpedia
producer_ref         = feat/research-public-links0
producer_commit      = 6833d9643826c6bf1dab71e596e50d8544335310
producer_pr           = #475 "RESEARCH-LINK0: resolve public Counterpedia
                         hrefs for governed refs" — OPEN / DRAFT as of this
                         lane (verified via `gh pr view 475 --repo
                         thelaplage/counterpedia`: isDraft=true,
                         mergedAt=null).

producer_module = lib/counterpedia/publicObjectLink.ts
  exports resolvePublicObjectLink(objectRef, objectKind) -> PublicObjectLinkResult
  PublicObjectLinkResult = {
    public_status: "public_link_available" | "no_public_route" | "unknown_ref" | "not_public",
    href?: string,   // present only when public_status === "public_link_available"
    label?: string,
  }

These are NOT literal producer output bytes (PublicObjectLink is a server
function with no public HTTP artifact yet, and its PR is still draft/
unratified) — they are hand-authored fixtures matching that exact pinned
TypeScript shape, labeled DRAFT/UNRATIFIED throughout this extension's code
and tests. When PR #475 lands and (if) a public transport for it exists,
these fixtures should be replaced with literal producer output the same way
the research_context_packet.*.json fixtures above were.
